integrity: Two independent complete ideal enumerations and two exact Hadamard transforms agree. Signed multiplier and projection-kernel histograms, direct character checks and Parseval checks are reproducible from C++17 source.
scientific_limitations: Exact analysis only for the stated product poset and its binary incidence representation.
No extrapolation to other hexagonal sizes or arbitrary weighted ensembles.
Historical-priority checking is bounded, and independent validation is not performed.
title: Exact Walsh spectrum and optimal endpoint projection for \(2\times3\times4\) boxed plane partitions
